note: Regional park on Del Clark Lake at the edge of Canby, run by the Lac qui Parle-Yellow Bank Watershed District. Wooded loops set back from the lake, with a public beach, swimming raft, fishing T-dock and trails beside them. Seasonal campers hold their own sites; short-term sites are separate. --Claude
summary: District pages read: 70 graveled back-ins 40-65 ft (separate short-term and seasonal sites), water + electric (sewer only on seasonal sites, cleared), showers, dump, season May 1-Oct 1 2026, request-form booking, $33 W/E tax included from a table headed 2023, $5 daily park pass. Not waterfront confirmed on imagery. camplinq aggregator link out; phone question flagged.
flags: RATE DATE: the only posted rate table is headed '2023 Rates' (still live 2026-11-11), older than the 2024+ rule; written with fees.checked '2023'. A local campground, so no price gate.

LONG-STAY (local park with seasonal campers): 'There are separate sites for weekenders and seasonal campers'; 'Seasonal sites are currently filled. Please contact management to join the waitlist.'; seasonal rates $1,700-$2,500 May 1-Oct 1. Nightly is sold ($33 a day posted, a reservation request form, 'Short-term Sites for weekend or weekday', news page 'Campsites are filling up fast make sure to get a reservation ASAP'), so test 2 passes; the district gives no count of short-term vs seasonal sites, so the nightly share is unmeasured. Imagery shows most pads in the wooded loops occupied by trailers (seasonal-heavy look). I do not read it as mostly seasonal on the evidence available, but the share is unknown.
